vocab.gloss: only natural; as it should be; certainly

example.pinyin: Wǒ dāngrán huì bāng nǐ a!

vocab.gloss: to receive; to answer (the phone); to meet or welcome sb

example.pinyin: Wǒ qù jiéyùn zhàn jiē nǐ, hǎo ma?
example.gloss: I'll go meet you at the MRT station, OK?

vocab.gloss: to be convinced (that sth is true); to believe; to accept sth as true

example.pinyin: Wǒ xiāngxìn nǐ zuò de dào.
example.gloss: I believe you can do it.

example.hanzi: 這些花真好看，是誰送的？
example.pinyin: Zhèxiē huā zhēn hǎokàn, shì shéi sòng de?
example.gloss: These flowers are really pretty—who gave them to you?

vocab.gloss: although; even though (often used correlatively with 是 or 是 etc)

example.hanzi: 雖然外面下雨，我還是要出去。
example.pinyin: Suīrán wàimiàn xià yǔ, wǒ háishì yào chūqù.
example.gloss: Although it's raining outside, I still want to go out.

vocab.gloss: to solve; to resolve; to settle (a problem); to eliminate; to wipe out (an enemy, bandits etc)

example.hanzi: 這個問題我們一起解決。

grammar.title: 雖然……但是/還是……
grammar.pattern: 雖然 + A，但是／還是 + B
grammar.explanation: 雖然 introduces a fact, and the second clause gives a contrasting result. In Chinese both halves are usually marked: 雖然 in the first clause, and 但是 (but) or 還是 (still) in the second. Unlike English, you keep both words.

examples.hanzi: 雖然很累，但是我很快樂。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ hěn kuàilè.
examples.gloss: Although I'm tired, I'm very happy.

examples.hanzi: 雖然他很忙，但是他當然會來接我。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dànshì tā dāngrán huì lái jiē wǒ.
examples.gloss: Although he's busy, of course he'll come to pick me up.

examples.hanzi: 雖然這個問題很大，我還是相信我們能解決。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán zhège wèntí hěn dà, wǒ háishì xiāngxìn wǒmen néng jiějué.
examples.gloss: Although this problem is big, I still believe we can solve it.

dialogue.speaker: 小安
dialogue.hanzi: 喂，你現在方便接電話嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Wéi, nǐ xiànzài fāngbiàn jiē diànhuà ma?
dialogue.gloss: Hello, is it convenient for you to take a call now?

dialogue.speaker: 小安
dialogue.hanzi: 我的腳踏車有問題，想請你幫忙。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ de jiǎotàchē yǒu wèntí, xiǎng qǐng nǐ bāngmáng.
dialogue.gloss: There's something wrong with my bike; I'd like to ask for your help.

dialogue.speaker: 小東
dialogue.hanzi: 沒問題，我相信我們可以解決。
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí, wǒ xiāngxìn wǒmen kěyǐ jiějué.
dialogue.gloss: No problem, I believe we can solve it.

dialogue.speaker: 小安
dialogue.hanzi: 謝謝你！我請你喝珍珠奶茶。
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ! Wǒ qǐng nǐ hē zhēnzhū nǎichá.
dialogue.gloss: Thank you! I'll treat you to bubble tea.

dialogue.speaker: 小東
dialogue.hanzi: 好啊！雖然我很忙，但是幫你當然沒問題。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo a! Suīrán wǒ hěn máng, dànshì bāng nǐ dāngrán méi wèntí.
dialogue.gloss: Sure! Although I'm busy, helping you is of course no problem.

sentences.pinyin: Tā qù jīchǎng jiē wǒ mèimei.
sentences.gloss: He's going to the airport to meet my younger sister.

sentences.pinyin: Zhèxiē huā shì shéi sòng de?
Suīrán hěn wǎn le, wǒ háishì xiǎng kàn diànshì.
sentences.gloss: Although it's late, I still want to watch TV.

sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí hěn kuài jiù jiějué le.
sentences.gloss: This problem was solved very quickly.

vocab.gloss: pertaining to; concerning; with regard to

example.hanzi: 關於這件事，我想跟你說一下。
example.pinyin: Guānyú zhè jiàn shì, wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ shuō yíxià.
example.gloss: Regarding this matter, I'd like to talk with you for a moment.

example.hanzi: 他很快就完成了這件事。
example.pinyin: Tā hěn kuài jiù wánchéng le zhè jiàn shì.
example.gloss: He finished this task very quickly.

example.hanzi: 電影快結束了，我們走吧。
example.pinyin: Diànyǐng kuài jiéshù le, wǒmen zǒu ba.
example.gloss: The movie is about to end; let's go.

vocab.gloss: to make an effort; to try hard; to strive; hard-working; conscientious

example.hanzi: 他每天都很努力，考試考得很好。
example.pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu hěn nǔlì, kǎoshì kǎo de hěn hǎo.
example.gloss: He works hard every day and does well on tests.

example.pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián bú huì qí jiǎotàchē.
example.gloss: I didn't know how to ride a bike before.

example.hanzi: 這個問題我沒有辦法解決。
example.pinyin: Zhè ge wèntí wǒ méiyǒu bànfǎ jiějué.
example.gloss: I have no way to solve this problem.

grammar.title: 用「關於」帶出話題
grammar.pattern: 關於 + 話題，+ 說明
grammar.explanation: 「關於」放在句子開頭，先點出要談的話題（人、事、問題），後面再說你的意見或情況。它不能直接當動詞用，後面一定要接一個名詞或事情。

examples.hanzi: 關於這次旅行，我們晚點再說。
examples.pinyin: Guānyú zhè cì lǚxíng, wǒmen wǎn diǎn zài shuō.
examples.gloss: As for this trip, let's talk about it later.

examples.hanzi: 關於那個問題，我還有很多不懂的地方。
examples.pinyin: Guānyú nà ge wèntí, wǒ hái yǒu hěn duō bù dǒng de dìfāng.
examples.gloss: Regarding that problem, there are still many things I don't understand.

examples.hanzi: 關於考試，你有什麼問題嗎？
examples.pinyin: Guānyú kǎoshì, nǐ yǒu shénme wèntí ma?
examples.gloss: Do you have any questions about the exam?

dialogue.speaker: 小安
dialogue.hanzi: 小東，你的報告完成了嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Xiǎo Dōng, nǐ de bàogào wánchéng le ma?
dialogue.gloss: Xiao Dong, have you finished your report?

dialogue.speaker: 小東
dialogue.hanzi: 還沒有。關於這個問題，我有很多地方不懂。
dialogue.pinyin: Hái méiyǒu. Guānyú zhè ge wèntí, wǒ yǒu hěn duō dìfāng bù dǒng.
dialogue.gloss: Not yet. Regarding this problem, there's a lot I don't understand.

dialogue.speaker: 小安
dialogue.hanzi: 你可以去問老師啊，他以前教過我，人很好。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ qù wèn lǎoshī a, tā yǐqián jiāo guò wǒ, rén hěn hǎo.
dialogue.gloss: You can go ask the teacher; he taught me before, he's really nice.

dialogue.speaker: 小東
dialogue.hanzi: 好，可是我一個人沒辦法完成，你能幫我嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, kěshì wǒ yí ge rén méi bànfǎ wánchéng, nǐ néng bāng wǒ ma?
dialogue.gloss: OK, but I can't finish it by myself. Can you help me?

dialogue.speaker: 小安
dialogue.hanzi: 沒問題！我們一起努力，這個週末一定可以完成。
dialogue.pinyin: Méi wèntí! Wǒmen yìqǐ nǔlì, zhè ge zhōumò yídìng kěyǐ wánchéng.
dialogue.gloss: No problem! Let's work hard together; we can definitely finish it this weekend.

dialogue.speaker: 小東
dialogue.hanzi: 太好了！今天的課結束後，我們就去咖啡店做吧。
dialogue.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Jīntiān de kè jiéshù hòu, wǒmen jiù qù kāfēi diàn zuò ba.
dialogue.gloss: Great! After class ends today, let's go to the café and work on it.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng wánchéng le zhè jiàn shì.
sentences.gloss: I have already completed this task.

sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān de kè kuài jiéshù le.
Guānyú zhè cì kǎoshì, lǎoshī shuō le hěn duō.
sentences.gloss: Regarding this exam, the teacher said a lot.

sentences.pinyin: Tā yǐqián bù nǔlì, xiànzài hěn nǔlì.
sentences.gloss: He didn't work hard before, but now he works very hard.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge wèntí wǒ méiyǒu bànfǎ huídá.
sentences.gloss: I have no way to answer this question.

vocab.gloss: unusual; special; very; especially; particularly; expressly; for a specific purpose

example.hanzi: 這家店的牛肉麵特別好吃。
example.pinyin: zhè jiā diàn de niú ròu miàn tè bié hǎo chī.
example.gloss: The beef noodles at this shop are especially delicious.

example.pinyin: zhè kè de zì hěn nán xiě.
example.gloss: The characters in this lesson are hard to write.

vocab.gloss: to take note of; to pay attention to

example.pinyin: qí jiǎo tà chē yào zhù yì ān quán.
example.gloss: You have to pay attention to safety when riding a bike.

vocab.gloss: to speak; to explain; to negotiate

example.hanzi: 老師講得很慢，我都聽得懂。
example.pinyin: lǎo shī jiǎng de hěn màn, wǒ dōu tīng de dǒng.
example.gloss: The teacher speaks slowly, so I can understand it all.

example.hanzi: 他昨天晚上八點離開公司。
example.pinyin: tā zuó tiān wǎn shàng bā diǎn lí kāi gōng sī.
example.gloss: He left the company at eight last night.

example.pinyin: zhè tái diàn nǎo yào sān wàn kuài.
example.gloss: This computer costs thirty thousand dollars.

grammar.title: 特別 + Adjective／Verb（especially, particularly）
grammar.explanation: 特別 goes before an adjective or verb to mean “especially / particularly”. It is stronger than 很 and is very common in daily Taiwan speech: 今天特別冷、這題特別難。It can also mean “special” before 的 (特別的日子).

examples.hanzi: 今天特別冷，你要多穿一件衣服。
examples.pinyin: jīn tiān tè bié lěng, nǐ yào duō chuān yí jiàn yī fú.
examples.gloss: It's especially cold today; wear one more layer.

examples.pinyin: zhè tí tè bié nán, wǒ bú huì zuò.
examples.gloss: This question is especially hard; I can't do it.

examples.pinyin: tā jīn tiān kàn qǐ lái tè bié lèi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: jīn tiān de zhōng wén kè nán bù nán?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 特別難！老師講得很快，我聽不懂。
dialogue.pinyin: tè bié nán! lǎo shī jiǎng de hěn kuài, wǒ tīng bù dǒng.
dialogue.gloss: Especially hard! The teacher spoke fast and I couldn't understand.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 你要注意聽，下課再去問老師。
dialogue.pinyin: nǐ yào zhù yì tīng, xià kè zài qù wèn lǎo shī.
dialogue.gloss: You should listen carefully, then ask the teacher after class.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 可是老師常常很快就離開教室了。
dialogue.pinyin: kě shì lǎo shī cháng cháng hěn kuài jiù lí kāi jiào shì le.
dialogue.gloss: But the teacher often leaves the classroom very quickly.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 那週末我們一起讀書吧。
dialogue.pinyin: nà zhōu mò wǒ men yì qǐ dú shū ba.
dialogue.gloss: Then let's study together this weekend.

sentences.pinyin: lǎo shī jiǎng de hěn kuài.
kāi chē yào zhù yì ān quán.
sentences.gloss: You must pay attention to safety when driving.

sentences.pinyin: tā yǐ jīng lí kāi tái běi le.
zhè ge fáng zi yào wǔ bǎi wàn.
